title: BulkDownloader session STATE pin
description: Single machine-readable source of truth for per-session state. Carried in the next-session pack; validated against the source zip by bd-state. Prose docs (CONTINUATION/KB_HANDOFF/Backlog/Roadmap) narrate; THIS file is the pin. If a prose doc disagrees with STATE.json, STATE.json + the source zip win.

live_version.description: version actually running on stash (operator-confirmed via /api/health)

built_version.description: highest BUILT but maybe-not-deployed version; == live_version when nothing is pending

deploy_status.description: deploy state. Historically a free-text status line; the enum tokens are the intended controlled vocabulary. Either form validates.

guards.description: release-guard path -> first-8 sha; ALL must be byte-identical to baseline unless a change is sha-declared

validation.description: on-stash binding-gate results. Either the structured object (intended) or a one-line capture summary string (what STATE has carried).

active_footguns.description: active footgun warnings carried forward; the real STATE key (the schema previously named a phantom 'open_footguns' that STATE never emitted)

static_kb_manifest_pin.description: sha256 of STATIC_KB_MANIFEST.json held OUTSIDE the PK -- the external pin that makes 'is this bundle CANON' answerable (the manifest cannot certify itself). bd-kb-sync verifies the pasted PK against this.
